about:
HRS Sheet Metal operates from Orlando, Florida, serving the Central Florida region including Tampa. The family‑owned shop was founded in 2022, emerging from a name change of the long‑standing J&R Conlon Sheet Metal. The transition preserved the same in‑house craftsmanship and commitment to custom fabrication that the predecessor had built over decades.

The company provides custom sheet metal fabrication, roofing system packages, and specialty metal products. Its capabilities include handmade fabrication, custom brake forming, commercial box gutter and downspout production, color matching, coping systems, custom chimney caps, and standing‑seam or exposed‑fastener roof panels. All work is performed in a centrally located facility that offers both pickup and delivery, with bilingual staff available to assist customers.

Primary customers are builders, developers, and contractors across Central Florida, covering both commercial and residential projects. The shop supplies architectural sheet metal components such as flashing, leaderheads, collection boxes, scuppers, and full metal roofing packages backed by manufacturer warranties.

HRS Sheet Metal emphasizes its 100‑plus years of combined team experience, emergency service availability, and free estimates delivered within 24‑48 hours. The business was started to bring tailored, handcrafted metal solutions to the local construction community with a focus on precision, quick turnaround, and approachable pricing.
